name: Toy Train
desc: Colorful toy train with locomotive and carriages
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const carr=Math.min(ctx.carriages||2,3); const carW=52; const carH=42; const gap=6; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; // Locomotive (rightmost) const locoX = carr*0.5*(carW+gap); svg += `<rect x="${locoX-carW/2}" y="${-carH}" width="${carW}" height="${carH}" rx="3" fill="#2A5A6A" stroke="#1A3A4A" stroke-width="${ol}"/>`; svg += `<rect x="${locoX-carW/2+3}" y="${-carH+8}" width="${carW-6}" height="${carH*0.55}" rx="2" fill="#F0C030" stroke="#D0A020" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; // Windows etc. simplified // Carriages for(let i=0;i<carr;i++){ const cx = -i*(carW+gap) + (carr-1)*0.5*(carW+gap); const colors = ['#3A8ACA','#E0882A','#FF4466']; const col = colors[i%colors.length]; svg += `<rect x="${cx-carW/2}" y="${-carH}" width="${carW}" height="${carH}" rx="3" fill="${col}" stroke="#2A6AA0" stroke-width="${ol}"/>`; // wheels for(let w=0;w<2;w++){ const wx=cx-14+w*28; svg += `<circle cx="${wx}" cy="${2}" r="6" fill="#333" stroke="#222" stroke-width="${ol*0.4}"/>`; svg += `<circle cx="${wx}" cy="${2}" r="3" fill="#555"/>`; } // coupling if(i<carr-1){ svg += `<line x1="${cx+carW/2}" y1="${-5}" x2="${cx-(carW+gap)-carW/2}" y2="${-5}" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>`; } } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
